The runtime already has _policy_promotion_runner and _policy_promotion_owner_recheck, which checks the candidate/evidence/run binding using an ephemeral promotion_write_allowed boolean; that is a local preflight, not a typed permit issuer/current verifier. four_planes.our_admission: At D production source 3b31, Level6PromotionStage.evaluate refuses the effectful runner path when the permit/verifier/revoke-serialized commit bridge is absent and emits promotion_admission_status=bridge_missing. The adjacent internal boolean helper checks candidate and evidence-bundle/run binding, but Level6 does not admit that boolean as a current typed permit. A supplied prepared promotion payload is interpreted read-only. The committed tests exercise false/truthy marker shapes and the revoke barrier; there is no valid-permit positive.
four_planes.claim_reaction: Report current L6 behavior as fail-closed bridge_missing and capability as not_established. Keep held. Do not describe the earlier G truthy normalizer as a current D defect.
